description.value: A free, reservation-free wilderness hut in the Okanagan & Thompson backcountry, operated by the Osprey Snowheelers snowmobile club. The shelter features a fireplace but has no drinking water, no mattresses, and no internet. Publicly accessible with no fee, it offers a basic roofed rest point in a remote setting.
